lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows along the lateral flank, transitioning from a high-density labyrinthine pattern posterior to the gills to a regular, spaced grid across the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows, forming a rectilinear grid where high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant linear features run horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 visible high-luminance blobs, arranged in two irregular vertical columns with higher density observed on the anterior half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-contrast, elongated silhouettes (consistent with symbiotic organisms) along the ventral-lateral margin and near the pectoral fin insertion point.
